name: 샘플 - 커뮤니티 핫딜 수집 (클리앙 + 루리웹 RSS + 뽐뿌 RSS)

options.fields:
category = span.icon_keyword
title = span.list_subject > a:not(.list_reply)
link = span.list_subject > a:not(.list_reply) @href
comments = span.rSymph05
hits = span.hit
time = span.timestamp

options.rules:
source = "clien"
source_post_id = regex(link, "/jirum/(\\d+)")
id = format("{source}:{source_post_id}")
post_url = replace(link, "\\?.*$", "")
shop = regex(title, "^\\[(.+?)\\]")
product = trim(replace(replace(title, "^\\[.+?\\]", ""), "\\([^()]*\\)\\s*$", ""))
price = number(regex(title, "([\\d,]{2,})\\s*원"))
comments = number(comments)
hits = number(hits)
posted_at = datetime(time, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")
collected_at = now()
options.keep:
id
source
source_post_id
post_url
title
shop
product
price
category
author
comments
hits
posted_at
collected_at
